tagline: Short, calm practice between therapy sessions
brief: A home practice app for adults recovering language after a stroke. Often older, may use one hand, tires quickly. The logo should feel calm, hopeful and clinical but warm.
criteria: Success: readable at 16 px, works in one colour, feels steady rather than childlike, and avoids the brain, heart and pulse-line clichés of health apps.

concepts.name: Held R
concepts.idea: An R with a break in its stem, where one dot holds the gap like a word coming back.
rationale: Stays a clear R from 16 px upward
Steady construction reads clinical, rounded ends and the warm dot read human
Links directly to the name, so it can stand alone as the app icon

recommendation: Held R is the chosen logo: the clearest mark at every size, and it links directly to the name.
next_steps: Run a professional trademark search before any public pilot
Have the printer proof the colours before any print use
